headline: Titans Trade DT Jeffery Simmons To Bears
summary: The NFL’s next blockbuster trade has been worked out. Jeffery Simmons is on the move, with his Tennessee tenure coming to an end. The Pro Bowl defensive tackle is being traded from the Titans to the Bears, as first reported by The Ringer’s Tom Pelissero. headline: Packers' Christian Watson returns to play after hospital trip for chest injury
summary: Christian Watson was determined to get back on the field Thursday despite coughing up blood and having to take an ambulance ride to get an X-ray and a CT scan.
